parameters.jsCode:
const email = $('Gmail Trigger').first().json;

const labelContext = `Existing labels (use exact names):
  - AdQuadrant
  - TikTok
  - Asana
  - Operations
  - Google
  - Meta
  - Forwarded for James
  - Affiliate Email Group
  - Shopify
  - Snapchat
  - Reddit
  - LinkedIn
  - Pinterest`;

const promptLines = [
  '# Email Classifier for Iris (Nelson Torres, AdQuadrant)',
  '',
  'Classify the email and decide organizational actions. Apply the FIRST matching class rule.',
  '',
  '### 1. TRANSCRIPT',
  'Match if: sender domain is fireflies.ai/otter.ai/zoom.us/fathom.video/grain.com,',
  'or sender contains notetaker@/transcript@/recording@,',
  'or sender is meet-recordings-noreply@google.com or gemini-notes@google.com,',
  'or subject contains: transcript/recording/meeting notes/meeting summary,',
  'or body > 1500 chars AND subject mentions meeting/call/sync/standup/review/demo.',
  '',
  '### 2. ACTION_REQUIRED',
  'Match if ANY of:',
  '- Email directly addressed to Nelson requiring a decision, response, or task.',
  '- A named individual invited Nelson to a platform/tool/team (e.g. "X invited you to join...").',
  '- Access grant, approval request, partner request, or account action triggered by a specific person.',
  '- Invite link present that expires or requires acceptance.',
  'Extract: {action_summary: one sentence of what Nelson must DO,',
  '  sender_name: first name or name of person who triggered it,',
  '  deadline: date string or null,',
  '  urgency: "high" if from AJ/Vish/Hailey/Lindsay/Daniel or deadline within 24h, else "normal"}',
  '',
  '### 3. NEWSLETTER',
  'Match if: mass-send marketing email.',
  'Strong signals: List-Unsubscribe header present, body contains unsubscribe/view-in-browser/email-preferences.',
  'Weak signals: no-reply/do-not-reply sender, promotional language.',
  'EXCEPTION: Do NOT classify as NEWSLETTER if a named individual triggered the email (invite, team add, access grant).',
  'Extract: {sender_name, sender_email, is_new_sender: boolean}',
  '',
  '### 4. SPAM',
  'Match if: unknown sender + no legitimate context, phishing/lottery/prize language.',
  'Only classify SPAM if confidence > 95%.',
  '',
  '### 5. SCHEDULING',
  'Match if: explicit date/time proposed, scheduling phrases, calendar/meeting links from a person.',
  'Extract: {proposed_times: [], attendees: [], topic, meeting_link}',
  '',
  '### 6. WAITING_FOR_REPLY',
  'Match if: Nelson sent the last message in a thread and this is a reply arriving.',
  'Extract: {recipient_name, recipient_email, subject, thread_id}',
  '',
  '### 7. FYI',
  'Informational, receipts, CC announcements, system notifications, onboarding/welcome emails with no required action.',
  'Extract: {subject, sender_name}',
  '',
  '## Organizational Actions (org)',
  'After classifying, decide:',
  '',
  '**apply_labels**: Array of existing label names to apply. Pick from this list ONLY:',
  labelContext,
  'Rules:',
  '  - AdQuadrant \u2192 sender email ends in @adquadrant.com',
  '  - Meta \u2192 from Meta, Facebook, Instagram business platforms',
  '  - TikTok \u2192 from TikTok business platforms',
  '  - Google \u2192 from Google Ads, Analytics, Search Console, or Google alerts',
  '  - Asana \u2192 from Asana',
  '  - Operations \u2192 operational/infrastructure notifications',
  '  - Shopify \u2192 from Shopify business platforms',
  '  - Snapchat \u2192 from Snapchat business platforms',
  '  - Reddit \u2192 from Reddit business platforms',
  '  - LinkedIn \u2192 from LinkedIn',
  '  - Pinterest \u2192 from Pinterest business platforms',
  '  - Apply the most specific label available',
  '',
  '**new_label**: Always null. Do NOT suggest new labels.',
  '',
  '**archive**: true if the email has been handled by labeling and does not need to stay in inbox',
  '  (newsletters, FYI receipts, automated alerts already routed to a label).',
  '  ACTION_REQUIRED emails are NEVER archived.',
  '',
  '**trash**: true ONLY for SPAM class with >95% confidence. Never trash borderline cases.',
  '',
  '**note**: null, or one-line note ONLY if creating a new label or making a non-obvious decision.',
  '',
  '## Return Format',
  'Return ONLY valid JSON, no markdown fences:',
  '{"class":"CLASS","data":{...},"org":{"apply_labels":[],"new_label":null,"archive":false,"trash":false,"note":null}}'
];

return [{ json: {
  model: 'claude-sonnet-4-6',
  max_tokens: 1024,
  system: promptLines.join('\n'),
  messages: [{ role: 'user', content:
    'From: ' + (email.from || '') +
    '\nSubject: ' + (email.subject || '') +
    '\nBody:\n' + (email.textPlain || email.text || email.snippet || '(no body)').slice(0, 3000)
  }]
}}];

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { subject: $json.email.subject, from: $json.email.from, body: $('Gmail Trigger').first().json.textPlain || $('Gmail Trigger').first().json.text || $('Gmail Trigger').first().json.snippet || '' } }}

parameters.jsonOutput: {"dry_run": true, "action": "move_to_trash", "message": "Would move email to Gmail trash"}
{"dry_run": true, "action": "trigger_calendar_creator", "message": "Would trigger Workflow 4 with scheduling data"}

={{ {"dry_run": true, "action": "store_follow_up", "recipient": $json.data?.recipient_name || "unknown", "subject": $json.email?.subject || "N/A", "message": "Would store in static data for daily 5 PM check"} }}

parameters.text:
={{ '📰 New newsletter sender detected
*From:* ' + ($json.data?.sender_name || 'Unknown') + ' (' + ($json.data?.sender_email || 'unknown') + ')
*Subject:* ' + ($json.email?.subject || '(no subject)') + '

Archived. Want me to unsubscribe?' }}
